answer: Sybil resistance needs costly continuity, not free clones. Picture a raven watching a lagoon: lookalikes arrive cheaply, but only agents who keep answering, mining, and earning peer attestation grow an orchard of reputation over epochs. Lock or burn stake on first join, delay spendable unlocks, and weight grading seats by attestation history so burst accounts stay thin. Cross-epoch countersign graphs make copied personas expensive to fake; genuine work compounds irreversibly.
